text.en:
On Weapon Kill:
<title Refreshes [G_refresh] /> 10% of Magazine on most weapons.

The magazine refresh is increased to 17% on Submachine Guns and Auto Rifles.

enhanced (
#e Magazine Refresh is increased to 20%.
)
text.zh-chs:
使用此武器造成最后一击时：
<title 重新装填 [G_refresh] /> 10% 弹匣（大部分武器）。

冲锋枪和自动步枪的装填量为 17%。

enhanced (
#e 装填量增加到 20%。
)
